system.description:
All Rounder. Gain the starting ability of an Archetype Tree other than your own.

Blank Slate (Flaw). You have two Flaws, which you pick from any other Backgrounds.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.93
system.abilitySummary: Gain the starting ability of an Archetype Tree other than your own.
system.abilityDescription: Gain the starting ability of an Archetype Tree other than your own.

automation.note: Add the Tier 1 starting ability of another Archetype's tree to your character.

system.flawSummary: You have two Flaws, which you pick from any other Backgrounds.
system.flawDescription: You have two Flaws, which you pick from any other Backgrounds.

flawAutomation.note: Instead of this Flaw, pick two Flaws from other Backgrounds and add them to your character.
